top_signals.title: Ukraine strikes third Yandex data center, disrupting digital services across Russia
top_signals.summary: A third Yandex data center in Russia was hit by Ukrainian drones over the weekend, forcing it to shut down and causing further disruptions to cloud services, payments, deliveries and other online services across the country.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: This Ultra-Rare Gas Could Become An Ace In Canada’s Hands
top_signals.summary: Back in July, the U.S. slapped an extra 50% duty on a wide range of Canadian exports, including items like dairy, alcohol and cement, with the Trump administration citing alleged Canadian trade discrimination against various U.S. goods. In response, Prime Minister Mark Carney’s government implemented dollar-for-dollar counter-tariffs targeting U.S. goods such as steel, aluminum, appliances and electronics as the tit-for-tat tariffs and trade war between the two nations escalated.
